parameters.title: Supplies the main title.
parameters.style: Stateful visual overrides before the list-tile theme.
parameters.subtitle: Adds a second line below the title.
parameters.leading: Places a widget before the main label.
parameters.trailing: Places a widget at the trailing edge.
parameters.onTap: Runs when the reader activates the component. Leave it unset for a read-only item.
parameters.enabled: Controls whether the row accepts input.
parameters.dragged: Applies the visual treatment for a dragged item.
parameters.contentPadding: Overrides the space around the row’s contents.
parameters.semanticLabel: What a screen reader says, over the content's own text.
parameters.focusNode: Supplies a focus node owned and disposed by the caller.
parameters.autofocus: Whether to take focus when first built.
parameters.selected: Whether the item is selected (checked, for a toggleable one).
